text: Boss mode 是一个面向 DSH 的多 Agent 工作预设，在模式选择器中加入“老板模式”。它用完整替换的系统提示引导主 Agent 制定计划、委派子任务、跟进与验收；提供启动子 Agent、发送后续消息、打断和查看子 Agent、维护待办，以及询问用户和管理持续目标等工作流程。预设还会限制继承来的全局工具，并让委派子 Agent 使用标准模式。适合需要拆分并持续跟踪多步任务的场景；源码未声明额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

Boss mode adds a DSH preset for delegated work. The main agent plans tasks, assigns subtasks, follows up, and reviews results using child-agent controls and a todo list. Children use the Standard preset. No extra API key or external service is declared.
想让主 Agent 把复杂任务拆开交给几个子 Agent 做，并持续跟进进度。
有没有一种 DSH 工作模式，可以由主 Agent 只负责安排、检查和协调？
I want a DSH agent workflow that can delegate subtasks, track them, and follow up across multiple steps.
Boss mode 的功能「委派并跟进多步工作」：主 Agent 可启动子 Agent、发送后续消息、查看或打断子 Agent，并用待办记录步骤；模式提示要求它检查报告后再验收。用户选择老板模式后按此流程协作。

@local/dsh-boss-mode README · Boss Mode for DeepSeek Harness：**Boss mode** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): the main agent never touches files. It plans, delegates, follows up, and verifies while subagents do all the work.

Adds one card to the mode picker: `老板模式` (id `boss`). Built-in modes are unchanged.

@local/dsh-boss-mode README · Install：1. Clone this repository.
2. Install it as a profile bundle: `plugin_manager` → `install_bundle`, target = this directory (or use Creator mode).
3. Restart DSH.

Requires a desktop/web profile with `dsh-base` + `dsh-web-app`; delegated children run the shipped Standard preset.

@local/dsh-boss-mode README · Tools：`subagent` · `send_message` · `interrupt_agent` · `list_agents` · `todo_write` · `ask_user_question` · `get_goal` / `create_goal` / `update_goal`

Children are durable and resume with `send_message` (delivery only — the answer arrives later). They cannot message each other; the parent relays.

@local/dsh-boss-mode README · Customize：The system prompt is `persona.prefix` under `preset-boss` in `cordis.patch.yml` (`complete: true`). Reinstall and restart DSH after editing. `index.js` masks the Host's globally registered tools.
